text: HUD helper line 'Kofi is helping: waiting for it to settle, 1:31 left' runs off the right edge at 640 wide; also unclear what 'waiting for it to settle' means while I push. Mailer issue reads 'certificate 62%  -60%/min left' - the '-60%/min left' phrase is hard to parse (rate? time left?).

Summit reached after ~39 s of held W (game time). Choice text is clear: 'It will roll back down with every module aboard. Or hold R to rewrite it: start again light, and lose most users'. Missing: how long the pause lasts (no countdown), and how long to hold R. Also R is the 'retire module' key everywhere else, so I worried holding R with the crosshair on the boulder would retire a module instead.

Holding R at the summit fills a 'Rewriting [####...]' bar (~3 s); releasing early keeps no message but the next hold completed. Confirmation shows twice in nearly the same words ('Rewrite chosen: it starts again light at the trailhead...' and 'A rewrite. It will start again light at the trailhead.'). HUD still shows Modules 13 / weight unchanged right after choosing, so the 'light' consequence isn't visible yet.

After choosing the rewrite, the roll-down banner says 'The platform it runs on reached its end of life. The boulder rolls. Every module goes with it.' - that is the text for the OTHER option (roll down with every module aboard). It contradicts the 'Rewrite chosen: starts again light' message I had just seen and made me doubt the rewrite registered. HUD still Modules 13, Users 500.

Rewrite landed: 'Rewritten. 6 fresh modules, and most of the users did not follow. 1.x starts here, light.' HUD Users 500->200, Modules 13->6, health 100%. Good payoff. But directions contradict each other on one screen: 'Next 1.1: 33 m uphill (behind you)', 'The boulder: 140 m ahead', and centre prompt 'The boulder is behind you, down the hill: go back down to it'. Boulder ahead or behind? Also Kofi's line 'on the way up, 0:49 left' has been frozen at 0:49 for ~30 s of game time since the summit.

Centre prompt 'The boulder is behind you, down the hill: go back down to it' stays on screen while the HUD line right above says 'The boulder: 8 m ahead' and the boulder is visibly in front of me - the centre prompt is stale/ignores facing.

History (Tab) marks the rewrite as '1.0*' with footnote '* rewritten at the summit (modules and users at the end, before the rewrite)'. Clear that a rewrite happened, but the table only shows the pre-rewrite 500 users / 13 modules - the cost of the decision (500->200 users, 13->6 modules) is not shown anywhere in History, so it does not read as a trade-off. Users bar chart makes 1.x (270) look like plain decline. Text drawn straight over the 3D scene with no backing panel; columns are cramped at 640 wide.
